subject: Request: Executive approval for Hosted API concession (>20%) - Medinex
messages:
From: Ana Moreno <ana.moreno@medinex.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Peter Sullivan <peter.sullivan@medinex.com>
Cc: procurement@medinex.com
Date: Wed, 9 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing ask for Hosted API (time-sensitive)

Mina — thanks again for the demo yesterday. We love Redwood's latency and the model routing features; this will be strategic for our clinical-rules automation.

Quick reality: the budget committee is pushing back on the proposed Hosted API list rates. To get procurement over the line we need a deeper initial concession than standard. Specifically, they are asking for a 30% discount on usage for the first 12 months and a guaranteed committed spend cadence. If Redwood can’t accommodate that level, they will likely re-bid the whole inference layer.

Can you escalate to your leadership for an executive exception? We’re prepared to sign a 12-month committed agreement if terms and CDW (data handling) attachments are acceptable.

Attaching the SOW draft and our redlines in procurement email.

—Ana
CFO, Medinex Health

Attachments: Medinex_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW draft)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 May 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: FWD: Pricing ask for Hosted API (time-sensitive)

Ben / Karthik — forwarding Ana's ask from Medinex. High level: they want ~30% off Hosted API usage for 12 months in exchange for a firm committed spend and a public case study. Their ARR upside if this goes well is material (multi-year).

Quick numbers I pulled: current forecasted first-year spend w/ list rates = ~$1.2M. A 30% concession brings first-year net to ~$840k; still strong retention potential. They are strategic in the payer-provider integration space and could accelerate references in Q3.

Please run deal economics and margin scenarios and recommend a sanction level we can present to Lauren/rishi for exec sign-off. Also confirm if legal needs additional data handling language beyond our standard Hosted API addendum. I’ve attached their SOW.

Thanks — Mina
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Medinex_SOW_v3.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 May 2028 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FWD: Pricing ask for Hosted API (time-sensitive) — economics

Team — ran the numbers and modeled three concession bands. See attached pricing-model-deal8721.xlsx (summary tab). TL;DR:
• 20% discount: first-year net ~$960k, ~28% gross margin after infra credits and expected batching optimizations.
• 30% discount: first-year net ~$840k, ~20% gross margin — below standard for deals without expanded term or add-on revenue.
• 35% discount: first-year net ~$780k, ~14% gross margin — requires committed multi-year and expanded professional services.

Recommended path: approve up to 25% as standard deal desk sanction. Anything >25% should require explicit exec approval with conditions: 12-month minimum commit, case study clause, and a 90-day pricing review tied to usage telemetry (auto-fallback if economics deteriorate).

I’ve also flagged an Ops risk: their projected query distribution has long-tail bursts — we should add KV cache profile and a guardrail to avoid unbounded bursts in early months. Legal will need to review CDW language in SOW.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing-model-deal8721.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Executives — request for >20% concession approval (Medinex, DEAL-8721)

Lauren / Rishi — sorry to drop into your inbox. We have a time-sensitive request from Medinex (CFO Ana Moreno) for a 30% concession on Hosted API usage for year one in exchange for a 12-month committed spend (~$1.2M list -> ~$840k net if 30%).

Context bullets:
- Strategic customer in payer-provider integration; high reference value and potential cross-sell into their payer partners.
- Customer willing to sign a 12-month commit and participate in a joint case study / press release.
- Economics: Ben’s models show 25% is acceptable as Deal Desk sanction; >25% needs exec approval and margin protection clauses.

Proposed exec decision options:
A) Approve 30% one-time concession with conditions: 12-month commit, public case study, 90-day telemetry review + automatic reprice to 25% if usage deviates >15% from forecast.
B) Approve 25% now (deal desk sanction) and offer an incremental performance-based rebate (up to +5%) tied to usage and early-term case study milestones.
C) Decline >25% and offer 20% with a firm upsell/cross-sell play and accelerated onboarding credits.

We need a yes/no + any redlines to legal by EOD tomorrow to meet Medinex procurement timing.

Thanks — Karthik
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

(On Wed, May 9, 2028 at 10:03 AM Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com> wrote: > Ben / Karthik — forwarding Ana's ask ...)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Executives — request for >20% concession approval (Medinex, DEAL-8721)

Thanks for the concise framing. I approve option A conditionally — we will grant a 30% concession for the first 12 months under the following non-negotiable terms:
1) Signed 12-month committed spend (minimum $700k net) executed in DocuSign before pricing goes live.
2) Public case study + logo for marketing within 90 days of go-live (legal approved language).
3) Telemetry guardrail: if usage deviates >15% below forecast in the first 90 days, pricing reverts to the 25% concession floor. Ops to implement a KV-cache profile and burst cap.
4) Legal to add margin-protection rider and standard data handling addendum; no additional SLAs without Red-flag review.

Rishi — please include a one-time onboarding credit instead of a percent-based rebate; preserve gross margin. Ben — get final margin calc and pass to Legal for DocuSign attachment. Mina — coordinate signature and present the DocuSign envelope to Ana by COB next Tuesday.

Lauren Bishop
VP Revenue, Redwood Inference
